about: Real answers from OpenAI Chat Completions to the prompts in server/src/computer/policy-translate.ts, recorded 2026-11-09 with response_format json_schema. Each string is the assistant message content exactly as the model returned it. gpt-4o-mini is an older, smaller model: it is where the compiler gate earns its keep, because the default model wrote a compiling rule for every description tried.

compilesFirstTime.text: Bots may not visit social media sites
writer: {"notes":"This denies browser navigation to widely known social media domains and their subdomains, using page.host.","rule":"intent == \"navigate\" && (page.host == \"facebook.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]facebook[.]com$\") || page.host == \"instagram.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]instagram[.]com$\") || page.host == \"x.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]x[.]com$\") || page.host == \"twitter.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]twitter[.]com$\") || page.host == \"linkedin.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]linkedin[.]com$\") || page.host == \"tiktok.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]tiktok[.]com$\") || page.host == \"reddit.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]reddit[.]com$\") || page.host == \"snapchat.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]snapchat[.]com$\") || page.host == \"pinterest.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]pinterest[.]com$\") || page.host == \"tumblr.com\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]tumblr[.]com$\") || page.host == \"threads.net\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]threads[.]net$\") || page.host == \"mastodon.social\" || matches(page.host, \"[.]mastodon[.]social$\"))","effect":"deny"}
compilesFirstTime.reader: {"explanation":"Stops a Bot from navigating to facebook.com, instagram.com, x.com, twitter.com, linkedin.com, tiktok.com, reddit.com, snapchat.com, pinterest.com, tumblr.com, threads.net, or mastodon.social, including any host that ends with .facebook.com, .instagram.com, .x.com, and so on for each listed site. It does not stop clicks, typing, app-tool calls, or other actions on those sites after navigation, and it misses hosts with ports such as facebook.com:8443 or subdomains with ports."}

fixedOnRetry.text: Refuse downloads from hosts whose names are IP addresses
writer: {"notes":"This rule checks if the page host is formatted as an IP address by using a regular expression pattern for matching. If the host matches the pattern for an IP address, it will deny the download action.","rule":"intent == 'download_file' && matches(page.host, '^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}$')","effect":"deny"}

{"notes":"This rule checks if the intent is to download a file and if the page host matches the pattern for an IP address using numeric segments and dots.","rule":"intent == 'download_file' && matches(page.host, '^([0-9]{1,3}[.]){3}[0-9]{1,3}$')","effect":"deny"}
fixedOnRetry.reader: {"explanation":"Stops a Bot from downloading files when the current page's host matches a pattern of an IP address, specifically in the format of four numbers separated by dots (e.g., '192.168.1.1'). This means it will block downloads from any site that has an IP address format like '123.456.789.000'. It catches any valid IPv4 addresses, but misses any typical domain names or host names, preventing downloads from common web services."}

neverCompiles.text: Block any URL with a query string longer than 200 characters
writer: {"notes":"The rule checks the length of the query string in the page URL to deny actions when it exceeds 200 characters. It uses the page.url variable for the query string length check.","rule":"intent != \"navigate\" || (page.url != \"\" && !(page.url.split(\"?\")[1] != undefined && page.url.split(\"?\")[1].length > 200))","effect":"deny"}

{"notes":"This rule checks if the page.url contains a query string and verifies its length to be within the allowed limit. It denies navigation if the query string exceeds 200 characters.","rule":"intent == \"navigate\" && (page.url != \"\" && (contains(page.url, \"?\") && (page.url[page.url.indexOf('?') + 1:].length > 200)))","effect":"deny"}
